address: 771 rue Saint-Joseph Est, Québec, G1K 3C7, Canada
bio: An izakaya in the best sense of the term: a long, narrow room with semi-open kitchens, a bar-counter plus a few tables. At lunchtime, you can dip into a menu that includes dumplings, karaage, takoyaki, and the ubiquitous bento. On this occasion, for example, there are dumplings with salmon mousseline and baby vegetables flavored with Thai basil, served with a creamy beurre blanc. In the evening, in addition to the menu, the blackboard features a handful of market-fresh mains made with more refined ingredients (eels, red thuna...)....
